title: construct daemon adapter
description: The one file, .construct/daemon/<name>/adapter.json, through which a repository connects an adapter to the daemon core. Every path is relative to the repository root and every command runs there.

extension.description: The unpacked browser extension the core loads.

directory.description: The directory the browser loads the extension from.

build.description: A command that builds the directory before the browser launches.

prepare.description: A command run inside the sandbox before the browser launches, given the lab copy path and the object id as its two arguments: config and data substitution, including what a route cannot reach in the service worker.

objects.description: A command printing one JSON object per line, one per object the daemon runs.

mechanic.description: The prompt file for the fresh agent of one object.

success.description: A command given the object's evidence directory: exit 0 or 1 and one line of reason.
